notes: Searches: all 6 used, the hard cap. Fetches: 10 used, of 60. Only one record was publishable. Most search results were news and listings from 2009 to 2019, and the main local list sources (Northeast Times, Philadelphia Neighborhoods, Free Library) returned 403, so the Frankford, Northwood, Lawncrest, Summerdale, Juniata Park and Crescentville groups have no current dated evidence and sit in leads_only. No own website was found for any of them. Crescentville and Castor Gardens (south) produced no group at all in this run. The 20 to 40 record target was not reached. Fox Chase Town Watch and Civic Association is outside this slice but shows 2026 meetings, so the Northeast lane should check it. The Council District 6, 7 and 9 assignments of these neighborhoods were not verified in this run. Suggested follow-up: a fresh wave with more searches on specific group names (library branch Friends groups, rec center advisory councils, parish programs in Frankford and Lawncrest, Juniata Park youth leagues), and a retry of the blocked list pages later.

records.name: Oxford Circle Christian Community Development Association
records.summary: A Christian community development group in Oxford Circle that runs a weekly food handout, after-school help and a summer camp for kids, adult job and education classes, and family literacy activities.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers pack food boxes for the Thursday handout, help with after-school tutoring and literacy activities, and can sign up for roles through the group's volunteer page.

schedule.text: Food handout on Thursdays and family literacy activities on the last Saturday of each month, as described in a 2022 article. Current times are not shown on the group's site.

cost.text: Not shown on the group's site

first_step.how: Call (215) 288-8504 or email contact@occcda.org, or use the volunteer page on occcda.org

records.notes: The group's own site (occcda.org) lists programs, volunteer and contact pages, and a Facebook and Instagram presence, but shows no dated items. The newest dated evidence is an Aug 18, 2022 article, so status follows the rule and is dormant. Confirm the Thursday food handout and volunteer openings before visiting. Eligibility is not stated on the site; 'residents' comes from the 2022 article's description of who gets food. A Quaker meeting notice names this group for a Sept 29 talk but shows no year, so it is not used as evidence. A 2020 Philadelphia Neighborhoods item refers to an 'Oxford Circle Community Development Association' that may be this same group; it was not fetched and is not written as a separate record.
